physical_metadata.model: 3D inextensible unshearable Kirchhoff strain Ritz; exact SO(3) frame updates and midpoint centerline embedding
physical_metadata.configuration: four Legendre curvature coefficients in each of two bending axes and torsion by default; all are dynamical
physical_metadata.mass: configuration dependent; includes translational and rotary inertia from embedding Jacobians
physical_metadata.KAM_status: Standard nonresonant elliptic KAM is not certified; circular isotropic rod with axial bias has paired bending frequencies.
physical_metadata.relation_to_full_model: Shares material, distal magnet and field interface with the Cosserat model; shear/stretch omitted in this analytical ROM; modal truncation and fluid/contact closure errors are not yet bounded.
physical_metadata.input: SI increment above axial bias: Bx,By,Bz,Gxx,Gyy,Gxy,Gxz,Gyz
physical_metadata.drag: synthetic smooth gamma*P; not a blood/contact closure
physical_metadata.derivatives: double-precision automatic differentiation through full variable-mass SO(3) geometry

cache.source: New coefficients of the unchanged frozen Hhat and unchanged S5 R; no old H_ideal b2 reused
cache.derivative: sequential reverse AD; same cache formulas; Torch2.5.1 complex vmap limitation

cache_reuse_check.interpretation: Only algorithm and same-load b1 inherited; H-dependent b2 recomputed for the network.

cache_domain.interpretation: Exact rational bound for the fixed saved cache polynomial; not a true network/ROM error certificate or floating execution enclosure.

floating_ball_bound.interpretation: Analytic sufficient bound on the specified Euclidean ball for the cached polynomial; coefficients evaluated in floating point, not an interval certificate.

integration.interpretation: Distinct finite-window numerical errors, not uniform domain learning bounds; no integrator-order claim here.
